I could not confirm a DOI for this exact title, and I was wrong earlier to tie 10.1515/THLI.2008.007 to Croft & Poole. Their article is [10.1515/THLI.2008.001](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/document/doi/10.1515/THLI.2008.001/html), and .007 is a different article in the same issue whose title I could not verify ([source](https://degruyterbrill.com/document/doi/10.1515/THLI.2008.007/pdf)). The team note's alternative, 10.1515/lity.2008.007, is unverified, and I found no record of the title at all, so please check the title on [doi.org](https://doi.org) or Crossref before citing any DOI.

CONFIDENCE: 10
